meta.title: Web Performance & Technical SEO | Core Web Vitals | APalevich.Pro
meta.description: We improve Core Web Vitals, page speed, and technical SEO for web apps and marketing sites. Data driven optimization with measurable ranking and revenue impact.

hero.title: Faster Sites Rank Higher and Convert More
hero.description: Every 100ms of load time costs you conversions. We diagnose and fix the performance and SEO issues holding your site back, with before and after data at every step.

features.title: What We Optimize, and How We Measure It
features.description: Performance work without measurement is just guessing. We set baselines first.

cards.title: Core Web Vitals
cards.description: LCP, CLS, and INP improvements that lift your Google search rankings and user experience scores.

cards.title: Page Speed Optimization
cards.description: Image compression, critical CSS, resource hints, and lazy loading that cut Time to Interactive.

cards.title: Technical SEO Audit
cards.description: Crawlability, indexation, schema markup, canonical tags, and site architecture reviewed and corrected.

cards.title: JavaScript Performance
cards.description: Bundle analysis, code splitting, and removal of render blocking scripts that make your JS stop hurting you.

cards.title: Server & CDN Configuration
cards.description: Caching headers, edge delivery, and TTFB improvements that speed up delivery before the browser starts.

cards.title: Ongoing Monitoring
cards.description: Lighthouse CI, CrUX data, and ranking tracking, so performance regressions get caught before users notice.

approach.title: Measure First, Fix Second
approach.description: We don't touch your site until we know exactly what's hurting you and by how much.
bullets: Baseline audit: Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, CrUX, Search Console
Prioritize fixes by ranking and conversion impact
Implement in stages, so each change can be attributed
Validate improvement in field data, not just lab scores
Deliver a report your team can act on independently
